note: Each entry is an arrangement of 16 straight lines forming 72 non-overlapping triangles, given as exact rational coefficients (a, b, c) for a*x + b*y = c. All arrangements in this file are SIMPLE: no three lines concurrent, no two lines parallel. They are pairwise non-isomorphic (line relabeling and per-line order reflection) and also non-isomorphic to the arrangements in the sol*/ folders and to the previously published one.
